parameters.query: INSERT INTO campaigns(id,candidate_id,domain,status,daily_limit) SELECT $1,c.id,$2,'DRAFT',LEAST(10,25) FROM candidates c WHERE c.id=$3 AND c.owner_id=$4 RETURNING id AS campaign_id, candidate_id, domain;

INSERT INTO recipients(id,campaign_id,professor_name,professor_email,university,canonical_profile_url,research_interest,evidence_json,status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),$1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb,'DISCOVERED') ON CONFLICT (campaign_id,professor_email) DO UPDATE SET professor_name=EXCLUDED.professor_name, university=EXCLUDED.university, canonical_profile_url=EXCLUDED.canonical_profile_url, research_interest=EXCLUDED.research_interest, evidence_json=EXCLUDED.evidence_json RETURNING id, professor_name, professor_email, university, canonical_profile_url, research_interest, status;
